pkgmetadata.longdescription: NymVPN core components: the nym-vpnd daemon (which routes traffic through the Nym mixnet or over WireGuard), the nym-vpnc command-line client, the nym-exclude split-tunnel helper, the nym-socks5-proxy and the nym-diagnostic tool. The graphical client is shipped separately as net-vpn/nym-vpn-app.
